question.text: After a leverage breach, the excess exposure must be squared off:

answer.text: Immediately on the same day of breach
By end of the next working day

explanation.text: The Logic: The Cat III AIF must square-off (sell/buy) the excess exposure by end of the next working day and confirm to investors on the same day. The Trap: Same-day square-off is not operationally mandated; 7/30 day windows are not prescribed. Cross-Exam Context: Parallel reporting obligation on the Custodian to SEBI exists.
